prompts.name: cover-mulberry
prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Edit target: supplied mulberry activity poster. Redesign it into an exact 4:5 portrait poster, ideally 1170x1462. This is a deliberate new vertical composition, NOT a crop, not a landscape poster inside blank borders. Preserve all visual elements: deep purple orchard background, mulberry leaves and giant ripe mulberries, jam jar, flowing Chinese auspicious clouds, yellow booking capsule, red fruit seal at bottom right. Refined Chinese rural watercolor and guofeng illustration, warm parchment details; same recognizable campaign world as reference. Clear portrait hierarchy: eyebrow and place at top, large white Song-style title below, fruit and jam illustration occupying middle/lower half. Text must be readable and exact: eyebrow "农事活动预告 · 春季篇"; place "桑树湾果园"; main title "桑葚果酱"; subtitle "桑葚采摘 · 手作一罐紫时甜"; yellow capsule "4月20日 开放预约"; red seal "桑". Keep every text and seal inside 8% safe margins. No extra text, logos or watermarks.

prompts.name: game-paint-wide
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Reference image defines the watercolor world and character. Recompose into a panoramic 2.7:1 horizontal banner, requested size 1620x600. Full-bleed rural Chinese watercolor on warm paper, fine graphite details, warm olive greens and ochres. Same friendly round watermelon character painting at a rustic wooden table, visible face and painting brush, watercolor paper with fruit painting, paint tools, fruit basket, sleeping cat and rural orchard beyond. Spread the scene horizontally. Keep character face, hands, brush, painting and fruit basket in middle horizontal band, all within central 80% width and middle 65% height; distant landscape and table edges may crop. Character around x=58%, basket x=82%; lower left is calm table for white UI title overlay, no baked-in text. No lettering, no watermark, no border. NOT a vertical scene cropped into a banner.

prompts.name: game-plum-wide
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create the illustration for the card titled "农谚问答" with the UI subtitle "答对农谚，解锁果灵". Supporting style reference image is green-plum watercolor still life; change the scene to clearly communicate a proverb quiz and unlocking a fruit companion. Panoramic 2.7:1 landscape, target 1620x600. Warm Chinese rural watercolor and fine graphite on cream textured paper. On a rustic orchard study table, an OPEN illustrated farming almanac shows simple sun, rain, seedling and harvest drawings, and a wooden quiz tile bears one single clear question mark. A friendly small anthropomorphic green-plum fruit spirit with a leaf on its head emerges beside a little opened wooden keepsake box with its latch clearly open, suggesting a reward unlocked by learning. Include a few real green plums and twig, distant quiet cultivated fields. Main objects and companion in middle/right 75% of the frame, all important parts within central 70% height; lower-left remains pale quiet tabletop for app title overlay. Recognizable book/question cue and unlocked fruit character, NOT merely a jar of fruit. No written Chinese or English labels, no logos, no UI panels, no watermarks, no border, no glossy 3D. Same world and gentle charm as project's watercolor watermelon painter.

prompts.name: game-loquat-wide
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create banner for Chinese mini-program card titled "果灵识果", subtitle "拍张照片，认识它的故事". Input 1 is loquat still-life watercolor reference; input 2 is watercolor watermelon mascot world reference. Panoramic 2.7:1 horizontal composition, target 1620x600. Warm rural Chinese watercolor on cream paper, fine pencil outlines, olive leaves and honey-gold fruit. Show an actual identifiable cluster of golden loquats with long dark green leaves on a wooden orchard table at center-right, beside a small field-journal opened to a delicate botanical drawing of the SAME loquat with its leaf and seed cross-section. A human hand from left-middle holds a contemporary slim smartphone aimed at that real fruit cluster; its screen visibly shows the same loquats with four simple camera framing corners, communicating taking a fruit identification photo. At far right a small gentle watermelon fruit spirit observes the loquat, same character world as reference. Distant orchard trees soft and unobtrusive. The phone, botanical journal and real loquats must be clearly legible and all important parts within central 75% width and middle 70% height. Lower-left 25% is calm tabletop reserved for app text overlay. No generated words, labels, brand logos, watermark, frame, glossy 3D or collage. Illustration must tell the story of photographing and learning about fruit, not merely a still life of preserves.

prompts.name: farmer-story-scene
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create the header illustration for "果农故事专栏", a column about elderly orchard farmers sharing traditional fruit cultivation and harvest knowledge with visitors. Input 1 is the old farmer composition to improve; input 2 is the watercolor style to match. Warm Chinese rural watercolor, fine graphite, textured cream paper, muted olive and golden ochre. Exact 2:1 panoramic landscape intended 1308x654. An elderly Chinese orchard farmer in a straw hat and blue apron is talking warmly, holding a ripe fruit and pointing to a fruiting branch; two adult visitors face him listening, one holding a small field notebook. They stand together as a compact coherent group at center, with two baskets of harvested fruit near their feet. Clear eye contact and storytelling gesture, not unrelated people scattered around scenery. Orchard trees frame the sides, faint village and low hills behind. ALL people's full heads and bodies and baskets fit within the middle 52% of canvas height, between y=24% and y=76%; all main objects within central 80% width. Upper quarter only airy sky and foliage, lower quarter only loose path wash, safe for an alternate 3.4:1 center crop. Fine human anatomy, thoughtful faces, gentle natural daylight. Generic column illustration, do not imply exact likeness of a real farmer. No text, logos, watermark, border, phones or photorealism.
